$comment: Reviewed exemptions for pnpm lint:store (N-32, ADR-069). Each entry needs file + exact extracted text + reason; `rule` narrows it to one rule. Adding an entry is a review decision — say why the string is not in-app selling.

entries.reason: Sale category (SaleCategory enum) for what the shop sells to its own customers, e.g. a gym membership. A physical-world sale by the business, not a purchase inside the app (Guideline 3.1.3(e)).
